messages:
Riley (People Ops): Heads up everyone — QLE this week for me: I became legal guardian for my niece yesterday via court order. Need to add her to my medical and dental. What's the process and timeline?
Tess (People Ops): Congrats and thanks for the notice. Guardianship counts as a QLE. You'll have 30 days from the court date to request midyear enrollment.
Riley (People Ops): Great. She doesn't have an SSN yet (newborn), and the court order is scanned but unsigned copy from the clerk for now. Can I submit that to start?
Marco (Benefits): You can submit the court order copy to start the case. We typically need: 1) Court guardianship decree (certified copy when available), 2) Birth certificate, 3) Proof of residency (utility or lease showing your name and child's address), 4) SSN when issued. If SSN pending, include a signed attestation that you'll provide SSN within 60 days.
Marco (Benefits): For newborns, carriers often allow provisional enrollment while SSN is pending, but final confirmation requires SSN. We'll note "SSN pending" on submission.
PayrollBot: Payroll note: mid-period additions are prorated. Deductions begin after carrier effective date. If you add medical mid-month, expect the first deduction on the next payroll cycle after carrier confirms.
Riley (People Ops): Is there a secure uploader? Don't want to email court docs in Slack.
Tess (People Ops): Use the internal secure portal: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload. Subject line: "QLE - Add dependent (guardianship) - Riley". Attach current docs and mark SSN pending if newborn.
Riley (People Ops): Any special flags for COBRA or prior coverage? She was never on another US plan.
Marco (Benefits): Good. If there was prior coverage overseas or under another US plan we'd need proof of prior coverage date. Since none, standard submission. Carrier turnaround for QLEs is typically 7-14 business days. If carrier asks for certified court copy we'll request you upload it when received.
Riley (People Ops): Thanks. I'll upload the scanned court file and birth certificate tonight. Appreciate the quick help. :heart:
